note: Slim verse pack for the tahajjud investigation. Arabic (Uthmani Hafs) + 4 translations. The `fasting-for-compare` group exists so the comparison agent does not have to reopen the fasting pack.

tahajjud-verse.arabic: وَإِن كَادُواْ لَيَسۡتَفِزُّونَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيُخۡرِجُوكَ مِنۡهَاۖ وَإِذࣰ ا لَّا يَلۡبَثُونَ خِلَٰفَكَ إِلَّا قَلِيلࣰ ا
tahajjud-verse.saheeh: And indeed, they were about to drive you from the land to evict you therefrom. And then [when they do], they will not remain [there] after you, except for a little.
tahajjud-verse.khattab: They were about to intimidate you to drive you out of the land ˹of Mecca˺, but then they would not have survived after you ˹had left˺ except for a little while
tahajjud-verse.arberry: Indeed they were near to startling thee from the land, to expel thee from it, and then they would have tarried after thee only a little --
tahajjud-verse.pickthall: And they indeed wished to scare thee from the land that they might drive thee forth from thence, and then they would have stayed (there) but a little after thee.

tahajjud-verse.arabic: سُنَّةَ مَن قَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا قَبۡلَكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَاۖ وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحۡوِيلًا
tahajjud-verse.saheeh: [That is Our] established way for those We had sent before you of Our messengers; and you will not find in Our way any alteration.
tahajjud-verse.khattab: ˹This has been˺ Our way with the messengers We sent before you. And you will never find any change in Our way
tahajjud-verse.arberry: the wont of those We sent before thee of Our Messengers; thou wilt find no change to Our wont.
tahajjud-verse.pickthall: (Such was Our) method in the case of those whom We sent before thee (to mankind), and thou wilt not find for Our method aught of power to change.

tahajjud-verse.arabic: أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِدُلُوكِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَقُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡفَجۡرِۖ إِنَّ قُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ كَانَ مَشۡهُودࣰ ا
tahajjud-verse.saheeh: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the Qur'an of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.
tahajjud-verse.khattab: Observe the prayer from the decline of the sun until the darkness of the night and the dawn prayer, for certainly the dawn prayer is witnessed ˹by angels˺
tahajjud-verse.arberry: Perform the prayer at the sinking of the sun to the darkening of the night and the recital of dawn; surely the recital of dawn is witnessed.
tahajjud-verse.pickthall: Establish worship at the going down of the sun until the dark of night, and (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn. Lo! (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn is ever witnessed.

tahajjud-verse.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَتَهَجَّدۡ بِهِۦ نَافِلَةࣰ لَّكَ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَبۡعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامࣰ ا مَّحۡمُودࣰ ا
tahajjud-verse.saheeh: And from [part of] the night, pray with it as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.
tahajjud-verse.khattab: And rise at ˹the last˺ part of the night, offering additional prayers, so your Lord may raise you to a station of praise
tahajjud-verse.arberry: And as for the night, keep vigil a part of it, as a work of supererogation for thee; it may be that thy Lord will raise thee up to a laudable station.
tahajjud-verse.pickthall: And some part of the night awake for it, a largess for thee. It may be that thy Lord will raise thee to a praised estate.

tahajjud-verse.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدۡخِلۡنِي مُدۡخَلَ صِدۡقࣲ وَأَخۡرِجۡنِي مُخۡرَجَ صِدۡقࣲ وَٱجۡعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلۡطَٰنࣰ ا نَّصِيرࣰ ا
tahajjud-verse.saheeh: And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."
tahajjud-verse.khattab: And say, “My Lord! Grant me an honourable entrance and an honourable exit and give me a supporting authority from Yourself.”
tahajjud-verse.arberry: And say: 'My Lord, lead me in with a just ingoing, and lead me out with a just outgoing; grant me authority from Thee, to help me.'
tahajjud-verse.pickthall: And say: My Lord! Cause me to come in with a firm incoming and to go out with a firm outgoing. And give me from Thy presence a sustaining Power.

tahajjud-verse.arabic: وَقُلۡ جَآءَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡبَٰطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقࣰ ا
tahajjud-verse.saheeh: And say, "Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart."
tahajjud-verse.khattab: And declare, “The truth has come and falsehood has vanished. Indeed, falsehood is bound to vanish.”
tahajjud-verse.arberry: And say: 'The truth has come, and falsehood has vanished away; surely falsehood is ever certain to vanish.'
tahajjud-verse.pickthall: And say: Truth hath come and falsehood hath vanished away. Lo! falsehood is ever bound to vanish.

tahajjud-verse.arabic: وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءࣱ وَرَحۡمَةࣱ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارࣰ ا
tahajjud-verse.saheeh: And We send down of the Qur'an that which is healing and mercy for the believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
tahajjud-verse.khattab: We send down the Quran as a healing and mercy for the believers, but it only increases the wrongdoers in loss
tahajjud-verse.arberry: And We send down, of the Koran, that which is a healing and a mercy to the believers; and the unbelievers it increases not, except in loss.
tahajjud-verse.pickthall: And We reveal of the Qur'an that which is a healing and a mercy for believers though it increase the evil-doers in naught save ruin.

muzzammil-founding.saheeh: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],
muzzammil-founding.arberry: O thou enwrapped in thy robes,
muzzammil-founding.pickthall: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment!

muzzammil-founding.saheeh: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
muzzammil-founding.khattab: Stand all night ˹in prayer˺ except a little—
muzzammil-founding.arberry: keep vigil the night, except a little
muzzammil-founding.pickthall: Keep vigil the night long, save a little -

muzzammil-founding.saheeh: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
muzzammil-founding.khattab: ˹pray˺ half the night, or a little less
muzzammil-founding.arberry: (a half of it, or diminish a little,
muzzammil-founding.pickthall: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof

muzzammil-founding.arabic: أَوۡ زِدۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَرۡتِيلًا
muzzammil-founding.saheeh: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.
muzzammil-founding.khattab: or a little more—and recite the Quran ˹properly˺ in a measured way
muzzammil-founding.arberry: or add a little), and chant the Koran very distinctly;
muzzammil-founding.pickthall: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure,

muzzammil-founding.arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلۡقِي عَلَيۡكَ قَوۡلࣰ ا ثَقِيلًا
muzzammil-founding.saheeh: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
muzzammil-founding.khattab: ˹For˺ We will soon send upon you a weighty revelation
muzzammil-founding.arberry: Behold, We shall cast upon thee a weighty word;
muzzammil-founding.pickthall: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight.

muzzammil-founding.arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيۡلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطۡـࣰٔ ا وَأَقۡوَمُ قِيلًا
muzzammil-founding.saheeh: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
muzzammil-founding.khattab: Indeed, worship in the night is more impactful and suitable for recitation
muzzammil-founding.arberry: surely the first part of the night is heavier in tread, more upright in speech,
muzzammil-founding.pickthall: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain.

muzzammil-founding.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبۡحࣰ ا طَوِيلࣰ ا
muzzammil-founding.saheeh: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
muzzammil-founding.khattab: For during the day you are over-occupied ˹with worldly duties˺
muzzammil-founding.arberry: surely in the day thou hast long business.
muzzammil-founding.pickthall: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business.

muzzammil-founding.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلࣰ ا
muzzammil-founding.saheeh: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
muzzammil-founding.khattab: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly
muzzammil-founding.arberry: And remember the Name of thy Lord, and devote thyself unto Him very devoutly.
muzzammil-founding.pickthall: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -

muzzammil-founding.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيلࣰ ا
muzzammil-founding.saheeh: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
muzzammil-founding.khattab: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the east and the west. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, so take Him ˹alone˺ as a Trustee of Affairs
muzzammil-founding.arberry: Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He; so take Him for a Guardian.
muzzammil-founding.pickthall: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender -

muzzammil-founding.arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهۡجُرۡهُمۡ هَجۡرࣰ ا جَمِيلࣰ ا
muzzammil-founding.saheeh: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
muzzammil-founding.khattab: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say, and depart from them courteously
muzzammil-founding.arberry: And bear thou patiently what they say, and forsake them graciously.
muzzammil-founding.pickthall: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking.

muzzammil-founding.arabic: وَذَرۡنِي وَٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِي ٱلنَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيلًا
muzzammil-founding.saheeh: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
muzzammil-founding.khattab: And leave to Me the deniers—the people of luxury—and bear with them for a little while
muzzammil-founding.arberry: Leave Me to those who cry lies, those prosperous ones, and respite them a little,
muzzammil-founding.pickthall: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.

muzzammil-founding.arabic: ۞إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعۡلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدۡنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَنِصۡفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةࣱ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحۡصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرۡضَىٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضۡرِبُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَبۡتَغُونَ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۖ فَٱقۡرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنۡهُۚ وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقۡرِضُواْ ٱللَّهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنࣰ اۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرࣲ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيۡرࣰ ا وَأَعۡظَمَ أَجۡرࣰ اۚ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمُۢ
muzzammil-founding.saheeh: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
muzzammil-founding.khattab: Surely your Lord knows that you ˹O Prophet˺ stand ˹in prayer˺ for nearly two-thirds of the night, or ˹sometimes˺ half of it, or a third, as do some of those with you. Allah ˹alone˺ keeps a ˹precise˺ measure of the day and night. He knows that you ˹believers˺ are unable to endure this, and has turned to you in mercy. So recite ˹in prayer˺ whatever you can from the Quran. He knows that some of you will be sick, some will be travelling throughout the land seeking Allah’s bounty, and some fighting in the cause of Allah. So recite whatever you can from it. And ˹continue to˺ perform ˹regular˺ prayers, pay alms-tax, and lend to Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah far better and more rewarding. And seek Allah’s forgiveness. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful
muzzammil-founding.arberry: Thy Lord knows that thou keepest vigil nearly two-thirds of the night, or a half of it, or a third of it, and a party of those with thee; and God determines the night and the day. He knows that you will not number it, and He has turned towards you. Therefore recite of the Koran so much as is feasible. He knows that some of you are sick, and others journeying in the land, seeking the bounty of God, and others fighting in the way of God. So recite of it so much as is feasible. And perform the prayer, and pay the alms, and lend to God a good loan. Whatever good you shall forward to your souls' account, you shall find it with God as better, and mightier a wage. And ask God's forgiveness; God is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.
muzzammil-founding.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

muddaththir-parallel.saheeh: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
muddaththir-parallel.khattab: O you covered up ˹in your clothes˺
muddaththir-parallel.arberry: O thou shrouded in thy mantle,
muddaththir-parallel.pickthall: O thou enveloped in thy cloak,

muddaththir-parallel.saheeh: And do not confer favor to acquire more
muddaththir-parallel.khattab: Do not do a favour expecting more ˹in return˺
muddaththir-parallel.arberry: Give not, thinking to gain greater
muddaththir-parallel.pickthall: And show not favour, seeking wordly gain!

muddaththir-parallel.saheeh: But for your Lord be patient.
muddaththir-parallel.khattab: And persevere for ˹the sake of˺ your Lord
muddaththir-parallel.arberry: and be patient unto thy Lord.
muddaththir-parallel.pickthall: For the sake of thy Lord, be patient!

two-portraits.saheeh: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
two-portraits.khattab: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs
two-portraits.arberry: Surely the godfearing shall be among gardens and fountains
two-portraits.pickthall: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,

two-portraits.arabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ
two-portraits.saheeh: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
two-portraits.khattab: ˹joyfully˺ receiving what their Lord will grant them. Before this ˹reward˺ they were truly good-doers ˹in the world˺
two-portraits.arberry: taking whatsoever their Lord has given them; they were good-doers before that.
two-portraits.pickthall: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;

two-portraits.arabic: كَانُواْ قَلِيلࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ مَا يَهۡجَعُونَ
two-portraits.saheeh: They used to sleep but little of the night,
two-portraits.khattab: they used to sleep only little in the night
two-portraits.arberry: Little of the night would they slumber,
two-portraits.pickthall: They used to sleep but little of the night,

two-portraits.saheeh: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
two-portraits.khattab: and pray for forgiveness before dawn
two-portraits.arberry: and in the mornings they would ask for forgiveness;
two-portraits.pickthall: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,

two-portraits.saheeh: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
two-portraits.khattab: And in their wealth there was a rightful share ˹fulfilled˺ for the beggar and the poor
two-portraits.arberry: and the beggar and the outcast had a share in their wealth.
two-portraits.pickthall: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.

two-portraits.saheeh: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
two-portraits.khattab: There are ˹countless˺ signs on earth for those with sure faith
two-portraits.arberry: In the earth are signs for those having sure faith;
two-portraits.pickthall: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.

two-portraits.saheeh: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
two-portraits.khattab: as there are within yourselves. Can you not see
two-portraits.arberry: and in your selves; what, do you not see?
two-portraits.pickthall: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?

two-portraits.saheeh: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
two-portraits.khattab: In heaven is your sustenance and whatever you are promised
two-portraits.arberry: And in heaven is your provision, and that you are promised.
two-portraits.pickthall: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;

two-portraits.arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقࣱّ مِّثۡلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمۡ تَنطِقُونَ
two-portraits.saheeh: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
two-portraits.khattab: Then by the Lord of heaven and earth! ˹All˺ this is certainly as true as ˹the fact that˺ you can speak
two-portraits.arberry: So by the Lord of heaven and earth, it is as surely true as that you have speech.
two-portraits.pickthall: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.

two-portraits.arabic: إِنَّمَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِهَا خَرُّواْۤ سُجَّدࣰ اۤ وَسَبَّحُواْ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ۩
two-portraits.saheeh: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.
two-portraits.khattab: The only ˹true˺ believers in Our revelation are those who—when it is recited to them—fall into prostration and glorify the praises of their Lord and are not too proud
two-portraits.arberry: Only those believe in Our signs who, when they are reminded of them, fall down prostrate and proclaim the praise of their Lord, not waxing proud.
two-portraits.pickthall: Only those believe in Our revelations who, when they are reminded of them, fall down prostrate and hymn the praise of their Lord, and they are not scornful,

two-portraits.arabic: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمَضَاجِعِ يَدۡعُونَ رَبَّهُمۡ خَوۡفࣰ ا وَطَمَعࣰ ا وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
two-portraits.saheeh: They arise from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
two-portraits.khattab: They abandon their beds, invoking their Lord with hope and fear, and donate from what We have provided for them
two-portraits.arberry: Their sides shun their couches as they call on their Lord in fear and hope; and they expend of that We have provided them.
two-portraits.pickthall: Who forsake their beds to cry unto their Lord in fear and hope, and spend of that We have bestowed on them.

two-portraits.arabic: فَلَا تَعۡلَمُ نَفۡسࣱ مَّآ أُخۡفِيَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعۡيُنࣲ جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
two-portraits.saheeh: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes as reward for what they used to do.
two-portraits.khattab: No soul can imagine what delights are kept in store for them as a reward for what they used to do
two-portraits.arberry: No soul knows what comfort is laid up for them secretly, as a recompense for that they were doing.
two-portraits.pickthall: No soul knoweth what is kept hid for them of joy, as a reward for what they used to do.

two-portraits.arabic: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤۡمِنࣰ ا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقࣰ اۚ لَّا يَسۡتَوُۥنَ
two-portraits.saheeh: Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.
two-portraits.khattab: Is the one who is a believer equal ˹before Allah˺ to the one who is rebellious? They are not equal
two-portraits.arberry: What? Is he who has been a believer like unto him who has been ungodly? They are not equal.
two-portraits.pickthall: Is he who is a believer like unto him who is an evil-liver? They are not alike.

two-portraits.arabic: أَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ نُزُلَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
two-portraits.saheeh: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.
two-portraits.khattab: As for those who believe and do good, they will have the Gardens of ˹Eternal˺ Residence—as an accommodation for what they used to do
two-portraits.arberry: As for those who believe, and do deeds of righteousness, there await them the Gardens of the Refuge, in hospitality for that they were doing.
two-portraits.pickthall: But as for those who believe and do good works, for them are the Gardens of Retreat - a welcome (in reward) for what they used to do.

night-standing.arabic: أَمَّنۡ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيۡلِ سَاجِدࣰ ا وَقَآئِمࣰ ا يَحۡذَرُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ وَيَرۡجُواْ رَحۡمَةَ رَبِّهِۦۗ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
night-standing.saheeh: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
night-standing.khattab: ˹Are they better˺ or those who worship ˹their Lord˺ devoutly in the hours of the night, prostrating and standing, fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of their Lord? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Are those who know equal to those who do not know?” None will be mindful ˹of this˺ except people of reason
night-standing.arberry: Or is he who is obedient in the watches of the night, bowing himself and standing, he being afraid of the world to come and hoping for the mercy of his Lord..? Say: 'Are they equal -- those who know and those who know not?' Only men possessed of minds remember.
night-standing.pickthall: Is he who payeth adoration in the watches of the night, prostrate and standing, bewaring of the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, (to be accounted equal with a disbeliever)? Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Are those who know equal with those who know not? But only men of understanding will pay heed.

night-standing.arabic: ۞لَيۡسُواْ سَوَآءࣰۗ مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ أُمَّةࣱ قَآئِمَةࣱ يَتۡلُونَ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَهُمۡ يَسۡجُدُونَ
night-standing.saheeh: They are not [all] the same; among the People of the Scripture is a community standing [in obedience], reciting the verses of Allah during periods of the night and prostrating [in prayer].
night-standing.khattab: Yet they are not all alike: there are some among the People of the Book who are upright, who recite Allah’s revelations throughout the night, prostrating ˹in prayer˺
night-standing.arberry: Yet they are not all alike; some of the People of the Book are a nation upstanding, that recite God's signs in the watches of the night, bowing themselves,
night-standing.pickthall: They are not all alike. Of the People of the Scripture there is a staunch community who recite the revelations of Allah in the night season, falling prostrate (before Him).

night-standing.arabic: يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِ وَيَأۡمُرُونَ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَيَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَيُسَٰرِعُونَ فِي ٱلۡخَيۡرَٰتِۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
night-standing.saheeh: They believe in Allah and the Last Day, and they enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and hasten to good deeds. And those are among the righteous.
night-standing.khattab: They believe in Allah and the Last Day, encourage good and forbid evil, and race with one another in doing good. They are ˹truly˺ among the righteous
night-standing.arberry: believing in God and in the Last Day, bidding to honour and forbidding dishonour, vying one with the other in good works; those are of the righteous.
night-standing.pickthall: They believe in Allah and the Last Day, and enjoin right conduct and forbid indecency, and vie one with another in good works. These are of the righteous.

night-standing.arabic: وَمَا يَفۡعَلُواْ مِنۡ خَيۡرࣲ فَلَن يُكۡفَرُوهُۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
night-standing.saheeh: And whatever good they do - never will it be removed from them. And Allah is Knowing of the righteous.
night-standing.khattab: They will never be denied the reward for any good they have done. And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of those mindful ˹of Him˺
night-standing.arberry: And whatsoever good you do, you shall not be denied the just reward of it; and God knows the godfearing.
night-standing.pickthall: And whatever good they do, they will not be denied the meed thereof. Allah is Aware of those who ward off (evil).

night-standing.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَن تُغۡنِيَ عَنۡهُمۡ أَمۡوَٰلُهُمۡ وَلَآ أَوۡلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـࣰٔ اۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
night-standing.saheeh: Indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
night-standing.khattab: Indeed, neither the wealth nor children of the disbelievers will be of any benefit to them against Allah. It is they who will be the residents of the Fire. They will be there forever
night-standing.arberry: As for the unbelievers, their riches shall not avail them, neither their children, against God; those are the inhabitants of the Fire, therein dwelling forever.
night-standing.pickthall: Lo! the riches and the progeny of those who disbelieve will not avail them aught against Allah; and such are rightful owners of the Fire. They will abide therein.

night-standing.arabic: مَثَلُ مَا يُنفِقُونَ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا كَمَثَلِ رِيحࣲ فِيهَا صِرٌّ أَصَابَتۡ حَرۡثَ قَوۡمࣲ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ فَأَهۡلَكَتۡهُۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِنۡ أَنفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُونَ
night-standing.saheeh: The example of what they spend in this worldly life is like that of a wind containing frost which strikes the harvest of a people who have wronged themselves and destroys it. And Allah has not wronged them, but they wrong themselves.
night-standing.khattab: The good they do in this worldly life is like the harvest of an evil people struck by a bitter wind, destroying it ˹completely˺. Allah never wronged them, but they wronged themselves
night-standing.arberry: The likeness of that they expend in this present life is as the likeness of a freezing blast that smites the tillage of a people who wronged themselves, and it destroyed that; God wronged them not, but themselves they wronged.
night-standing.pickthall: The likeness of that which they spend in this life of the world is as the likeness of a biting, icy wind which smiteth the harvest of a people who have wronged themselves, and devastateth it. Allah wronged them not, but they do wrong themselves.

night-standing.arabic: ۞قُلۡ أَؤُنَبِّئُكُم بِخَيۡرࣲ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمۡۖ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتࣱ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَأَزۡوَٰجࣱ مُّطَهَّرَةࣱ وَرِضۡوَٰنࣱ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ
night-standing.saheeh: Say, "Shall I inform you of [something] better than that? For those who fear Allah will be gardens in the presence of their Lord beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally, and purified spouses and approval from Allah. And Allah is Seeing of [His] servants -
night-standing.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Shall I inform you of what is better than ˹all of˺ this? Those mindful ˹of Allah˺ will have Gardens with their Lord under which rivers flow, to stay there forever, and pure spouses, along with Allah’s pleasure.” And Allah is All-Seeing of ˹His˺ servants
night-standing.arberry: Say: 'Shall I tell you of a better than that?' For those that are godfearing, with their Lord are gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein dwelling forever, and spouses purified, and God's good pleasure. And God sees His servants
night-standing.pickthall: Say: Shall I inform you of something better than that? For those who keep from evil, with their Lord, are Gardens underneath which rivers flow wherein they will abide, and pure companions, and contentment from Allah. Allah is Seer of His bondmen,

night-standing.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
night-standing.saheeh: Those who say, "Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire,"
night-standing.khattab: who pray, “Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive our sins and protect us from the torment of the Fire.”
night-standing.arberry: who say, 'Our Lord, we believe; forgive us our sins, and guard us against the chastisement of the Fire' --
night-standing.pickthall: Those who say: Our Lord! Lo! we believe. So forgive us our sins and guard us from the punishment of Fire;

night-standing.arabic: ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ وَٱلۡقَٰنِتِينَ وَٱلۡمُنفِقِينَ وَٱلۡمُسۡتَغۡفِرِينَ بِٱلۡأَسۡحَارِ
night-standing.saheeh: The patient, the true, the obedient, those who spend [in the way of Allah], and those who seek forgiveness before dawn.
night-standing.khattab: ˹It is they˺ who are patient, sincere, obedient, and charitable, and who pray for forgiveness before dawn
night-standing.arberry: men who are patient, truthful, obedient, expenders in alms, imploring God's pardon at the daybreak.
night-standing.pickthall: The steadfast, and the truthful, and the obedient, those who spend (and hoard not), those who pray for pardon in the watches of the night.

night-standing.arabic: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمۡشُونَ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ هَوۡنࣰ ا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُواْ سَلَٰمࣰ ا
night-standing.saheeh: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
night-standing.khattab: The ˹true˺ servants of the Most Compassionate are those who walk on the earth humbly, and when the foolish address them ˹improperly˺, they only respond with peace
night-standing.arberry: The servants of the All-merciful are those who walk in the earth modestly and who, when the ignorant address them, say, 'Peace';
night-standing.pickthall: The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace;

night-standing.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمۡ سُجَّدࣰ ا وَقِيَٰمࣰ ا
night-standing.saheeh: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
night-standing.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who spend ˹a good portion of˺ the night, prostrating themselves and standing before their Lord
night-standing.arberry: who pass the night prostrate to their Lord and standing;
night-standing.pickthall: And who spend the night before their Lord, prostrate and standing,

night-standing.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصۡرِفۡ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
night-standing.saheeh: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
night-standing.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who pray, “Our Lord! Keep the punishment of Hell away from us, for its punishment is indeed unrelenting
night-standing.arberry: who say, 'Our Lord, turn Thou from us the chastisement of Gehenna; surely its chastisement is torment most terrible;
night-standing.pickthall: And who say: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish;

night-standing.arabic: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرࣰّ ا وَمُقَامࣰ ا
night-standing.saheeh: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
night-standing.khattab: It is certainly an evil place to settle and reside.”
night-standing.arberry: evil it is as a lodging-place and an abode';
night-standing.pickthall: Lo! it is wretched as abode and station;

night-standing.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُواْ لَمۡ يُسۡرِفُواْ وَلَمۡ يَقۡتُرُواْ وَكَانَ بَيۡنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامࣰ ا
night-standing.saheeh: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
night-standing.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who spend neither wastefully nor stingily, but moderately in between
night-standing.arberry: who, when they expend, are neither prodigal nor parsimonious, but between that is a just stand;
night-standing.pickthall: And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two;

night-standing.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدۡعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقۡتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفۡسَ ٱلَّتِي حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا يَزۡنُونَۚ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ يَلۡقَ أَثَامࣰ ا
night-standing.saheeh: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
night-standing.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who do not invoke any other god besides Allah, nor take a ˹human˺ life—made sacred by Allah—except with ˹legal˺ right, nor commit fornication. And whoever does ˹any of˺ this will face the penalty
night-standing.arberry: who call not upon another god with God, nor slay the soul God has forbidden except by right, neither fornicate, for whosoever does that shall meet the price
night-standing.pickthall: And those who cry not unto any other god along with Allah, nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden save in (course of) justice, nor commit adultery - and whoso doeth this shall pay the penalty;

night-standing.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَمۡ يَخِرُّواْ عَلَيۡهَا صُمࣰّ ا وَعُمۡيَانࣰ ا
night-standing.saheeh: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
night-standing.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who, when reminded of the revelation of their Lord, do not turn a blind eye or a deaf ear to it
night-standing.arberry: who, when they are reminded of the signs of their Lord, fall not down thereat deaf and blind;
night-standing.pickthall: And those who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.

night-standing.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعۡيُنࣲ وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
night-standing.saheeh: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."
night-standing.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who pray, “Our Lord! Bless us with ˹pious˺ spouses and offspring who will be the joy of our hearts, and make us models for the righteous.”
night-standing.arberry: who say, 'Our Lord, give us refreshment of our wives and seed, and make us a model to the godfearing.'
night-standing.pickthall: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil).

night-standing.arabic: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُجۡزَوۡنَ ٱلۡغُرۡفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيُلَقَّوۡنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةࣰ وَسَلَٰمًا
night-standing.saheeh: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace.
night-standing.khattab: It is they who will be rewarded with ˹elevated˺ mansions ˹in Paradise˺ for their perseverance, and will be received with salutations and ˹greetings of˺ peace
night-standing.arberry: Those shall be recompensed with the highest heaven, for that they endured patiently, and they shall receive therein a greeting and --' Peace!'
night-standing.pickthall: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace,

night-standing.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۚ حَسُنَتۡ مُسۡتَقَرࣰّ ا وَمُقَامࣰ ا
night-standing.saheeh: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
night-standing.khattab: staying there forever. What an excellent place to settle and reside
night-standing.arberry: Therein they shall dwell forever; fair it is as a lodging-place and an abode.
night-standing.pickthall: Abiding there for ever. Happy is it as abode and station!

night-standing.arabic: قُلۡ مَا يَعۡبَؤُاْ بِكُمۡ رَبِّي لَوۡلَا دُعَآؤُكُمۡۖ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبۡتُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامَۢا
night-standing.saheeh: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.
night-standing.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “You ˹all˺ would not ˹even˺ matter to my Lord were it not for your faith ˹in Him˺. But now you ˹disbelievers˺ have denied ˹the truth˺, so the torment is bound to come.”
night-standing.arberry: Say: 'My Lord esteems you not at all were it not for your prayer, for you have cried lies, and it shall surely be fastened.'
night-standing.pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment.

command-to-glorify.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبࣲ‏
command-to-glorify.saheeh: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
command-to-glorify.khattab: Indeed, We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, and We were not ˹even˺ touched with fatigue
command-to-glorify.arberry: We created the heavens and the earth, and what between them is, in six days, and no weariness touched Us.
command-to-glorify.pickthall: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.

command-to-glorify.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ ٱلۡغُرُوبِ
command-to-glorify.saheeh: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
command-to-glorify.khattab: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset
command-to-glorify.arberry: So be thou patient under what they say, and proclaim thy Lord's praise before the rising of the sun, and before its setting,
command-to-glorify.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;

command-to-glorify.saheeh: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.
command-to-glorify.khattab: And glorify Him during part of the night and after the prayers
command-to-glorify.arberry: and proclaim thy Lord's praise in the night, and at the ends of the prostrations.
command-to-glorify.pickthall: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.

command-to-glorify.arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
command-to-glorify.saheeh: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
command-to-glorify.khattab: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise
command-to-glorify.arberry: And be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord; surely thou art before Our eyes. And proclaim the praise of thy Lord when thou arisest,
command-to-glorify.pickthall: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,

command-to-glorify.saheeh: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
command-to-glorify.khattab: And glorify Him during part of the night and at the fading of the stars
command-to-glorify.arberry: and proclaim the praise of thy Lord in the night, and at the declining of the stars.
command-to-glorify.pickthall: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.

command-to-glorify.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَنزِيلࣰ ا
command-to-glorify.saheeh: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
command-to-glorify.khattab: Indeed, it is We Who have revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ in stages
command-to-glorify.arberry: Surely We have sent down the Koran on thee, a sending down;
command-to-glorify.pickthall: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;

command-to-glorify.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ ءَاثِمًا أَوۡ كَفُورࣰ ا
command-to-glorify.saheeh: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
command-to-glorify.khattab: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not yield to any evildoer or ˹staunch˺ disbeliever from among them
command-to-glorify.arberry: so be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord, and obey not one of them, sinner or unbeliever.
command-to-glorify.pickthall: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.

command-to-glorify.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةࣰ وَأَصِيلࣰ ا
command-to-glorify.saheeh: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
command-to-glorify.khattab: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening
command-to-glorify.arberry: And remember the Name of thy Lord at dawn and in the evening
command-to-glorify.pickthall: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.

command-to-glorify.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَٱسۡجُدۡ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلࣰ ا طَوِيلًا
command-to-glorify.saheeh: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
command-to-glorify.khattab: and prostrate before Him during part of the night, and glorify Him long at night
command-to-glorify.arberry: and part of the night; bow down before Him and magnify Him through the long night.
command-to-glorify.pickthall: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.

command-to-glorify.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ غُرُوبِهَاۖ وَمِنۡ ءَانَآيِٕ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡ وَأَطۡرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرۡضَىٰ
command-to-glorify.saheeh: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.
command-to-glorify.khattab: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset, and glorify Him in the hours of the night and at both ends of the day, so that you may be pleased ˹with the reward˺
command-to-glorify.arberry: So be thou patient under what they say, and proclaim thy Lord's praise before the rising of the sun, and before its setting, and proclaim thy Lord's praise in the watches of the night, and at the ends of the day; haply thou wilt be well-pleasing.
command-to-glorify.pickthall: Therefor (O Muhammad), bear with what they say, and celebrate the praise of thy Lord ere the rising of the sun and ere the going down thereof. And glorify Him some hours of the night and at the two ends of the day, that thou mayst find acceptance.

command-to-glorify.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقࣱّ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِبۡكَٰرِ
command-to-glorify.saheeh: So be patient, [O Muhammad]. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.
command-to-glorify.khattab: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺, ˹for˺ Allah’s promise is certainly true. Seek forgiveness for your shortcomings. And glorify the praises of your Lord morning and evening
command-to-glorify.arberry: So be thou patient; surely God's promise is true. And ask forgiveness for thy sin, and proclaim the praise of thy Lord at evening and dawn.
command-to-glorify.pickthall: Then have patience (O Muhammad). Lo! the promise of Allah is true. And ask forgiveness of thy sin, and hymn the praise of thy Lord at fall of night and in the early hours.

command-to-glorify.arabic: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمۡسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصۡبِحُونَ
command-to-glorify.saheeh: So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.
command-to-glorify.khattab: So glorify Allah in the evening and in the morning—
command-to-glorify.arberry: So glory be to God both in your evening hour and in your morning hour.
command-to-glorify.pickthall: So glory be to Allah when ye enter the night and when ye enter the morning -

command-to-glorify.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَعَشِيࣰّ ا وَحِينَ تُظۡهِرُونَ
command-to-glorify.saheeh: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.
command-to-glorify.khattab: all praise is for Him in the heavens and the earth—as well as in the afternoon, and at noon
command-to-glorify.arberry: His is the praise in the heavens and earth, alike at the setting sun and in your noontide hour.
command-to-glorify.pickthall: Unto Him be praise in the heavens and the earth! - and at the sun's decline and in the noonday.

command-to-glorify.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَل لِّيٓ ءَايَةࣰۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمۡزࣰ اۗ وَٱذۡكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرࣰ ا وَسَبِّحۡ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِبۡكَٰرِ
command-to-glorify.saheeh: He said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He Said, "Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to the people for three days except by gesture. And remember your Lord much and exalt [Him with praise] in the evening and the morning."
command-to-glorify.khattab: Zachariah said, “My Lord! Grant me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not ˹be able to˺ speak to people for three days except through gestures. Remember your Lord often and glorify ˹Him˺ morning and evening.”
command-to-glorify.arberry: 'Lord,' said Zachariah, 'appoint to me a sign.' 'Thy sign,' God said, 'is that thou shalt not speak, save by tokens, to men for three days. And mention thy Lord oft, and give glory at evening and dawn.'
command-to-glorify.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Appoint a token for me. (The angel) said: The token unto thee (shall be) that thou shalt not speak unto mankind three days except by signs. Remember thy Lord much, and praise (Him) in the early hours of night and morning.

command-to-glorify.arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابِ فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَن سَبِّحُواْ بُكۡرَةࣰ وَعَشِيࣰّ ا
command-to-glorify.saheeh: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon.
command-to-glorify.khattab: So he came out to his people from the sanctuary, signalling to them to glorify ˹Allah˺ morning and evening
command-to-glorify.arberry: So he came forth unto his people from the Sanctuary, then he made signal to them, 'Give you glory at dawn and evening.'
command-to-glorify.pickthall: Then he came forth unto his people from the sanctuary, and signified to them: Glorify your Lord at break of day and fall of night.

command-to-glorify.arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ
command-to-glorify.saheeh: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
command-to-glorify.khattab: We truly subjected the mountains to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with him in the evening and after sunrise
command-to-glorify.arberry: With him We subjected the mountains to give glory at evening and sunrise,
command-to-glorify.pickthall: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise,

prayer-timing.arabic: وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ طَرَفَيِ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَزُلَفࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلَّيۡلِۚ إِنَّ ٱلۡحَسَنَٰتِ يُذۡهِبۡنَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِۚ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكۡرَىٰ لِلذَّٰكِرِينَ
prayer-timing.saheeh: And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember.
prayer-timing.khattab: Establish prayer ˹O Prophet˺ at both ends of the day and in the early part of the night. Surely good deeds wipe out evil deeds. That is a reminder for the mindful
prayer-timing.arberry: And perform the prayer at the two ends of the day and nigh of the night; surely the good deeds will drive away the evil deeds. That is a remembrance unto the mindful.
prayer-timing.pickthall: Establish worship at the two ends of the day and in some watches of the night. Lo! good deeds annul ill-deeds. This is reminder for the mindful.

prayer-timing.arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجۡرَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
prayer-timing.saheeh: And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.
prayer-timing.khattab: And be patient! Certainly Allah does not discount the reward of the good-doers
prayer-timing.arberry: And be thou patient; God will not leave to waste the wage of the good-doers.
prayer-timing.pickthall: And have patience, (O Muhammad), for lo! Allah loseth not the wages of the good.

prayer-timing.arabic: أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِدُلُوكِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَقُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡفَجۡرِۖ إِنَّ قُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ كَانَ مَشۡهُودࣰ ا
prayer-timing.saheeh: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the Qur'an of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.
prayer-timing.khattab: Observe the prayer from the decline of the sun until the darkness of the night and the dawn prayer, for certainly the dawn prayer is witnessed ˹by angels˺
prayer-timing.arberry: Perform the prayer at the sinking of the sun to the darkening of the night and the recital of dawn; surely the recital of dawn is witnessed.
prayer-timing.pickthall: Establish worship at the going down of the sun until the dark of night, and (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn. Lo! (the recital of) the Qur'an at dawn is ever witnessed.

prayer-timing.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَتَهَجَّدۡ بِهِۦ نَافِلَةࣰ لَّكَ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَبۡعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامࣰ ا مَّحۡمُودࣰ ا
prayer-timing.saheeh: And from [part of] the night, pray with it as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.
prayer-timing.khattab: And rise at ˹the last˺ part of the night, offering additional prayers, so your Lord may raise you to a station of praise
prayer-timing.arberry: And as for the night, keep vigil a part of it, as a work of supererogation for thee; it may be that thy Lord will raise thee up to a laudable station.
prayer-timing.pickthall: And some part of the night awake for it, a largess for thee. It may be that thy Lord will raise thee to a praised estate.

prayer-timing.arabic: حَٰفِظُواْ عَلَى ٱلصَّلَوَٰتِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ٱلۡوُسۡطَىٰ وَقُومُواْ لِلَّهِ قَٰنِتِينَ
prayer-timing.saheeh: Maintain with care the [obligatory] prayers and [in particular] the middle prayer and stand before Allah, devoutly obedient.
prayer-timing.khattab: Observe the ˹five obligatory˺ prayers—especially the middle prayer—and stand in true devotion to Allah
prayer-timing.arberry: Be you watchful over the prayers, and the middle prayer; and do you stand obedient to God.
prayer-timing.pickthall: Be guardians of your prayers, and of the midmost prayer, and stand up with devotion to Allah.

prayer-timing.arabic: فَإِنۡ خِفۡتُمۡ فَرِجَالًا أَوۡ رُكۡبَانࣰ اۖ فَإِذَآ أَمِنتُمۡ فَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَمَا عَلَّمَكُم مَّا لَمۡ تَكُونُواْ تَعۡلَمُونَ
prayer-timing.saheeh: And if you fear [an enemy, then pray] on foot or riding. But when you are secure, then remember Allah [in prayer], as He has taught you that which you did not [previously] know.
prayer-timing.khattab: If you are in danger, pray on foot or while riding. But when you are safe, ˹take time to˺ remember Allah for teaching you what you did not know
prayer-timing.arberry: And if you are in fear, then afoot or mounted; but when you are secure, then remember God, as He taught you the things that you knew not.
prayer-timing.pickthall: And if ye go in fear, then (pray) standing or on horseback. And when ye are again in safety, remember Allah, as He hath taught you that which (heretofore) ye knew not.

prayer-timing.arabic: فَإِذَا قَضَيۡتُمُ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ فَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ قِيَٰمࣰ ا وَقُعُودࣰ ا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِكُمۡۚ فَإِذَا ٱطۡمَأۡنَنتُمۡ فَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَۚ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ كَانَتۡ عَلَى ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ كِتَٰبࣰ ا مَّوۡقُوتࣰ ا
prayer-timing.saheeh: And when you have completed the prayer, remember Allah standing, sitting, or [lying] on your sides. But when you become secure, re-establish [regular] prayer. Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers a decree of specified times.
prayer-timing.khattab: When the prayers are over, remember Allah—whether you are standing, sitting, or lying down. But when you are secure, establish regular prayers. Indeed, performing prayers is a duty on the believers at the appointed times
prayer-timing.arberry: When you have performed the prayer, remember God, standing and sitting and on your sides. Then, when you are secure, perform the prayer; surely the prayer is a timed prescription for the believers.
prayer-timing.pickthall: When ye have performed the act of worship, remember Allah, standing, sitting and reclining. And when ye are in safety, observe proper worship. Worship at fixed times hath been enjoined on the believers.

prayer-timing.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لِيَسۡتَـٔۡذِنكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَمۡ يَبۡلُغُواْ ٱلۡحُلُمَ مِنكُمۡ ثَلَٰثَ مَرَّٰتࣲۚ مِّن قَبۡلِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِنۢ بَعۡدِ صَلَوٰةِ ٱلۡعِشَآءِۚ ثَلَٰثُ عَوۡرَٰتࣲ لَّكُمۡۚ لَيۡسَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَلَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ جُنَاحُۢ بَعۡدَهُنَّۚ طَوَّٰفُونَ عَلَيۡكُم بَعۡضُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمࣱ‏
prayer-timing.saheeh: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allah make clear to you the verses; and Allah is Knowing and Wise.
prayer-timing.khattab: O believers! Let those ˹bondspeople˺ in your possession and those of you who are still under age ask for your permission ˹to come in˺ at three times: before dawn prayer, when you take off your ˹outer˺ clothes at noon, and after the late evening prayer. ˹These are˺ three times of privacy for you. Other than these times, there is no blame on you or them to move freely, attending to one another. This is how Allah makes the revelations clear to you, for Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise
prayer-timing.arberry: O believers, let those your right hands own and those of you who have not reached puberty ask leave of you three times -- before the prayer of dawn, and when you put off your garments at the noon, and after the evening prayer -- three times of nakedness for you. There is no fault in you or them, apart from these, that you go about one to the other. So God makes clear to you the signs; and God is All-knowing, All-wise.
prayer-timing.pickthall: O ye who believe! Let your slaves, and those of you who have not come to puberty, ask leave of you at three times (before they come into your presence): Before the prayer of dawn, and when ye lay aside your raiment for the heat of noon, and after the prayer of night. Three times of privacy for you. It is no sin for them or for you at other times, when some of you go round attendant upon others (if they come into your presence without leave). Thus Allah maketh clear the revelations for you. Allah is Knower, Wise.

witnessed-standing.saheeh: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
witnessed-standing.khattab: Put your trust in the Almighty, Most Merciful
witnessed-standing.arberry: Put thy trust in the All-mighty, the All-compassionate
witnessed-standing.pickthall: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.

witnessed-standing.saheeh: Who sees you when you arise
witnessed-standing.khattab: Who sees you when you rise ˹for prayer at night˺
witnessed-standing.arberry: who sees thee when thou standest
witnessed-standing.pickthall: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)

witnessed-standing.saheeh: And your movement among those who prostrate.
witnessed-standing.khattab: as well as your movements ˹in prayer˺ along with ˹fellow˺ worshippers
witnessed-standing.arberry: and when thou turnest about among those who bow.
witnessed-standing.pickthall: And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship).

witnessed-standing.saheeh: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
witnessed-standing.khattab: He ˹alone˺ is indeed the All-Hearing, All-Knowing
witnessed-standing.arberry: Surely He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.
witnessed-standing.pickthall: Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower.

witnessed-standing.saheeh: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].
witnessed-standing.khattab: Again, no! Never obey him ˹O Prophet˺! Rather, ˹continue to˺ prostrate and draw near ˹to Allah˺
witnessed-standing.arberry: No indeed; do thou not obey him, and bow thyself, and draw nigh.
witnessed-standing.pickthall: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).

witnessed-standing.arabic: وَٱذۡكُر رَّبَّكَ فِي نَفۡسِكَ تَضَرُّعࣰ ا وَخِيفَةࣰ وَدُونَ ٱلۡجَهۡرِ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ بِٱلۡغُدُوِّ وَٱلۡأٓصَالِ وَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡغَٰفِلِينَ
witnessed-standing.saheeh: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.
witnessed-standing.khattab: Remember your Lord inwardly with humility and reverence and in a moderate tone of voice, both morning and evening. And do not be one of the heedless
witnessed-standing.arberry: Remember thy Lord in thy soul, humbly and fearfully, not loud of voice, at morn and eventide. Be not thou among the heedless.
witnessed-standing.pickthall: And do thou (O Muhammad) remember thy Lord within thyself humbly and with awe, below thy breath, at morn and evening. And be not thou of the neglectful.

witnessed-standing.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ عَنۡ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَيُسَبِّحُونَهُۥ وَلَهُۥ يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
witnessed-standing.saheeh: Indeed, those who are near your Lord are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, and they exalt Him, and to Him they prostrate.
witnessed-standing.khattab: Surely those ˹angels˺ nearest to your Lord are not too proud to worship Him. They glorify Him. And to Him they prostrate
witnessed-standing.arberry: Surely those who are with thy Lord wax not too proud to serve Him; they chant His praise, and to Him they bow.
witnessed-standing.pickthall: Lo! those who are with thy Lord are not too proud to do Him service, but they praise Him and prostrate before Him.

witnessed-standing.arabic: إِنَّ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
witnessed-standing.saheeh: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding.
witnessed-standing.khattab: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the day and night there are signs for people of reason
witnessed-standing.arberry: Surely in the creation of the heavens and earth and in the alternation of night and day there are signs for men possessed of minds
witnessed-standing.pickthall: Lo! In the creation of the heavens and the earth and (in) the difference of night and day are tokens (of His Sovereignty) for men of understanding,

witnessed-standing.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَذۡكُرُونَ ٱللَّهَ قِيَٰمࣰ ا وَقُعُودࣰ ا وَعَلَىٰ جُنُوبِهِمۡ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقۡتَ هَٰذَا بَٰطِلࣰ ا سُبۡحَٰنَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
witnessed-standing.saheeh: Who remember Allah while standing or sitting or [lying] on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth, [saying], "Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
witnessed-standing.khattab: ˹They are˺ those who remember Allah while standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth ˹and pray˺, “Our Lord! You have not created ˹all of˺ this without purpose. Glory be to You! Protect us from the torment of the Fire
witnessed-standing.arberry: who remember God, standing and sitting and on their sides, and reflect upon the creation of the heavens and the earth: 'Our Lord, Thou hast not created this for vanity. Glory be to Thee! Guard us against the chastisement of the Fire.
witnessed-standing.pickthall: Such as remember Allah, standing, sitting, and reclining, and consider the creation of the heavens and the earth, (and say): Our Lord! Thou createdst not this in vain. Glory be to Thee! Preserve us from the doom of Fire.

witnessed-standing.arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ مَن تُدۡخِلِ ٱلنَّارَ فَقَدۡ أَخۡزَيۡتَهُۥۖ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ أَنصَارࣲ‏
witnessed-standing.saheeh: Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.
witnessed-standing.khattab: Our Lord! Indeed, those You commit to the Fire will be ˹completely˺ disgraced! And the wrongdoers will have no helpers
witnessed-standing.arberry: Our Lord, whomsoever Thou admittest into the Fire, Thou wilt have abased; and the evildoers shall have no helpers.
witnessed-standing.pickthall: Our Lord! Whom Thou causest to enter the Fire: him indeed Thou hast confounded. For evil-doers there will be no helpers.

witnessed-standing.arabic: رَّبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعۡنَا مُنَادِيࣰ ا يُنَادِي لِلۡإِيمَٰنِ أَنۡ ءَامِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَـَٔامَنَّاۚ رَبَّنَا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرۡ عَنَّا سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ
witnessed-standing.saheeh: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.
witnessed-standing.khattab: Our Lord! We have heard the caller to ˹true˺ belief, ˹proclaiming,˺ ‘Believe in your Lord ˹alone˺,’ so we believed. Our Lord! Forgive our sins, absolve us of our misdeeds, and allow us ˹each˺ to die as one of the virtuous
witnessed-standing.arberry: Our Lord, we have heard a caller calling us to belief, saying, "Believe you in your Lord!" And we believe. Our Lord, forgive Thou us our sins and acquit us of our evil deeds, and take us to Thee with the pious.
witnessed-standing.pickthall: Our Lord! Lo! we have heard a crier calling unto Faith: "Believe ye in your Lord!" So we believed. Our Lord! Therefor forgive us our sins, and remit from us our evil deeds, and make us die the death of the righteous.

witnessed-standing.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَءَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخۡزِنَا يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۖ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخۡلِفُ ٱلۡمِيعَادَ
witnessed-standing.saheeh: Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise."
witnessed-standing.khattab: Our Lord! Grant us what You have promised us through Your messengers and do not put us to shame on Judgment Day—for certainly You never fail in Your promise.”
witnessed-standing.arberry: Our Lord, give us what Thou hast promised us by Thy Messengers, and abase us not on the Day of Resurrection; Thou wilt not fail the tryst.'
witnessed-standing.pickthall: Our Lord! And give us that which Thou hast promised to us by Thy messengers. Confound us not upon the Day of Resurrection. Lo! Thou breakest not the tryst.

sleep-as-sign.arabic: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبۡتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَسۡمَعُونَ
sleep-as-sign.saheeh: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
sleep-as-sign.khattab: And one of His signs is your sleep by night and by day ˹for rest˺ as well as your seeking His bounty ˹in both˺. Surely in this are signs for people who listen
sleep-as-sign.arberry: And of His signs is your slumbering by night and day, and your seeking after His bounty. Surely in that are signs for a people who hear.
sleep-as-sign.pickthall: And of His signs is your slumber by night and by day, and your seeking of His bounty. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who heed.

sleep-as-sign.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ لِبَاسࣰ ا وَٱلنَّوۡمَ سُبَاتࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورࣰ ا
sleep-as-sign.saheeh: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.
sleep-as-sign.khattab: He is the One Who has made the night for you as a cover, and ˹made˺ sleep for resting, and the day for rising
sleep-as-sign.arberry: It is He who appointed the night for you to be a garment and sleep for a rest, and day He appointed for a rising.
sleep-as-sign.pickthall: And He it is Who maketh night a covering for you, and sleep repose, and maketh day a resurrection.

sleep-as-sign.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلۡأَنفُسَ حِينَ مَوۡتِهَا وَٱلَّتِي لَمۡ تَمُتۡ فِي مَنَامِهَاۖ فَيُمۡسِكُ ٱلَّتِي قَضَىٰ عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَيُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
sleep-as-sign.saheeh: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
sleep-as-sign.khattab: ˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ calls back the souls ˹of people˺ upon their death as well as ˹the souls˺ of the living during their sleep. Then He keeps those for whom He has ordained death, and releases the others until ˹their˺ appointed time. Surely in this are signs for people who reflect
sleep-as-sign.arberry: God takes the souls at the time of their death, and that which has not died, in its sleep; He withholds that against which He has decreed death, but looses the other till a stated term. Surely in that are signs for a people who reflect. Or have they taken intercessors apart from God?
sleep-as-sign.pickthall: Allah receiveth (men's) souls at the time of their death, and that (soul) which dieth not (yet) in its sleep. He keepeth that (soul) for which He hath ordained death and dismisseth the rest till an appointed term. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who take thought.

sleep-as-sign.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا جَرَحۡتُم بِٱلنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبۡعَثُكُمۡ فِيهِ لِيُقۡضَىٰٓ أَجَلࣱ مُّسَمࣰّ ىۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
sleep-as-sign.saheeh: And it is He who takes your souls by night and knows what you have committed by day. Then He revives you therein that a specified term may be fulfilled. Then to Him will be your return; then He will inform you about what you used to do.
sleep-as-sign.khattab: He is the One Who calls back your souls by night and knows what you do by day, then revives you daily to complete your appointed term. To Him is your ˹ultimate˺ return, then He will inform you of what you used to do
sleep-as-sign.arberry: It is He who recalls you by night, and He knows what you work by day; then He raises you up therein, that a stated term may be determined; then unto Him shall you return, then He will tell you of what you have been doing.
sleep-as-sign.pickthall: He it is Who gathereth you at night and knoweth that which ye commit by day. Then He raiseth you again to life therein, that the term appointed (for you) may be accomplished. And afterward unto Him is your return. Then He will proclaim unto you what ye used to do.

sleep-as-sign.saheeh: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
sleep-as-sign.khattab: and made your sleep for rest
sleep-as-sign.arberry: and We appointed your sleep for a rest;
sleep-as-sign.pickthall: And have appointed your sleep for repose,

sleep-as-sign.saheeh: And made the night as clothing
sleep-as-sign.khattab: and made the night as a cover
sleep-as-sign.arberry: and We appointed night for a garment,
sleep-as-sign.pickthall: And have appointed the night as a cloak,

sleep-as-sign.saheeh: And made the day for livelihood
sleep-as-sign.khattab: and made the day for livelihood
sleep-as-sign.arberry: and We appointed day for a livelihood.
sleep-as-sign.pickthall: And have appointed the day for livelihood.

sleep-as-sign.arabic: وَتَحۡسَبُهُمۡ أَيۡقَاظࣰ ا وَهُمۡ رُقُودࣱۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمۡ ذَاتَ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ ٱلشِّمَالِۖ وَكَلۡبُهُم بَٰسِطࣱ ذِرَاعَيۡهِ بِٱلۡوَصِيدِۚ لَوِ ٱطَّلَعۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ لَوَلَّيۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ فِرَارࣰ ا وَلَمُلِئۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ رُعۡبࣰ ا
sleep-as-sign.saheeh: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.
sleep-as-sign.khattab: And you would have thought they were awake, though they were asleep. We turned them over, to the right and left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. Had you looked at them, you would have certainly fled away from them, filled with horror
sleep-as-sign.arberry: Thou wouldst have thought them awake, as they lay sleeping, while We turned them now to the right, now to the left,' and their dog 'stretching its paws on the threshold. Hadst thou observed them surely thou wouldst have turned thy back on them in flight, and been filled with terror of them.
sleep-as-sign.pickthall: And thou wouldst have deemed them waking though they were asleep, and We caused them to turn over to the right and the left, and their dog stretching out his paws on the threshold. If thou hadst observed them closely thou hadst assuredly turned away from them in flight, and hadst been filled with awe of them.

sleep-as-sign.arabic: إِذۡ يُغَشِّيكُمُ ٱلنُّعَاسَ أَمَنَةࣰ مِّنۡهُ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيۡكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ لِّيُطَهِّرَكُم بِهِۦ وَيُذۡهِبَ عَنكُمۡ رِجۡزَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ وَلِيَرۡبِطَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُمۡ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ ٱلۡأَقۡدَامَ
sleep-as-sign.saheeh: [Remember] when He overwhelmed you with drowsiness [giving] security from Him and sent down upon you from the sky, rain by which to purify you and remove from you the evil [suggestions] of Satan and to make steadfast your hearts and plant firmly thereby your feet.
sleep-as-sign.khattab: ˹Remember˺ when He caused drowsiness to overcome you, giving you serenity. And He sent down rain from the sky to purify you, free you from Satan’s whispers, strengthen your hearts, and make ˹your˺ steps firm
sleep-as-sign.arberry: When He was causing slumber to overcome you as a security from Him, and sending down on you water from heaven, to purify you thereby, and to put away from you the defilement of Satan, and to strengthen your hearts, and to confirm your feet.
sleep-as-sign.pickthall: When He made the slumber fall upon you as a reassurance from him and sent down water from the sky upon you, that thereby He might purify you, and remove from you the fear of Satan, and make strong your hearts and firm (your) feet thereby.

night-oaths.saheeh: By the dawn
night-oaths.khattab: By the dawn
night-oaths.arberry: By the dawn
night-oaths.pickthall: By the Dawn

night-oaths.saheeh: And [by] ten nights
night-oaths.khattab: and the ten nights
night-oaths.arberry: and ten nights,
night-oaths.pickthall: And ten nights,

night-oaths.saheeh: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
night-oaths.khattab: and the even and the odd
night-oaths.arberry: by the even and the odd,
night-oaths.pickthall: And the Even and the Odd,

night-oaths.saheeh: And [by] the night when it passes,
night-oaths.khattab: and the night when it passes
night-oaths.arberry: by the night when it journeys on!
night-oaths.pickthall: And the night when it departeth,

night-oaths.arabic: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمࣱ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ
night-oaths.saheeh: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
night-oaths.khattab: Is all this ˹not˺ a sufficient oath for those who have sense
night-oaths.arberry: Is there in that an oath for a mindful man?
night-oaths.pickthall: There surely is an oath for thinking man.

night-oaths.saheeh: By the night when it covers
night-oaths.khattab: By the night when it covers
night-oaths.arberry: By the night enshrouding
night-oaths.pickthall: By the night enshrouding

night-oaths.saheeh: And [by] the day when it appears
night-oaths.khattab: and the day when it shines
night-oaths.arberry: and the day in splendour
night-oaths.pickthall: And the day resplendent

night-oaths.saheeh: And [by] He who created the male and female,
night-oaths.khattab: And by ˹the One˺ Who created male and female
night-oaths.arberry: and That which created the male and the female,
night-oaths.pickthall: And Him Who hath created male and female,

night-oaths.saheeh: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
night-oaths.khattab: Surely the ends you strive for are diverse
night-oaths.arberry: surely your striving is to diverse ends.
night-oaths.pickthall: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).

night-oaths.saheeh: By the morning brightness
night-oaths.khattab: By the morning sunlight
night-oaths.arberry: By the white forenoon
night-oaths.pickthall: By the morning hours

night-oaths.saheeh: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
night-oaths.khattab: and the night when it falls still
night-oaths.arberry: and the brooding night!
night-oaths.pickthall: And by the night when it is stillest,

night-oaths.saheeh: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
night-oaths.khattab: Your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful ˹of you˺
night-oaths.arberry: Thy Lord has neither forsaken thee nor hates thee
night-oaths.pickthall: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,

night-oaths.saheeh: By the sun and its brightness
night-oaths.khattab: By the sun and its brightness
night-oaths.arberry: By the sun and his morning brightness
night-oaths.pickthall: By the sun and his brightness,

night-oaths.saheeh: And [by] the moon when it follows it
night-oaths.khattab: and the moon as it follows it
night-oaths.arberry: and by the moon when she follows him,
night-oaths.pickthall: And the moon when she followeth him,

night-oaths.saheeh: And [by] the day when it displays it
night-oaths.khattab: and the day as it unveils it
night-oaths.arberry: and by the day when it displays him
night-oaths.pickthall: And the day when it revealeth him,

night-oaths.saheeh: And [by] the night when it covers it
night-oaths.khattab: and the night as it conceals it
night-oaths.arberry: and by the night when it enshrouds him!
night-oaths.pickthall: And the night when it enshroudeth him,

night-oaths.saheeh: So I swear by the twilight glow
night-oaths.khattab: So, I do swear by the twilight
night-oaths.arberry: No! I swear by the twilight
night-oaths.pickthall: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,

night-oaths.saheeh: And [by] the night and what it envelops
night-oaths.khattab: And by the night and whatever it envelops
night-oaths.arberry: and the night and what it envelops
night-oaths.pickthall: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,

night-oaths.saheeh: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
night-oaths.khattab: And by the moon when it waxes full
night-oaths.arberry: and the moon when it is at the full,
night-oaths.pickthall: And by the moon when she is at the full,

night-oaths.saheeh: [That] you will surely experience state after state.
night-oaths.khattab: You will certainly pass from one state to another
night-oaths.arberry: you shall surely ride stage after stage.
night-oaths.pickthall: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.

night-oaths.saheeh: And by the night as it closes in
night-oaths.khattab: and the night as it falls
night-oaths.arberry: by the night swarming,
night-oaths.pickthall: And the close of night,

night-oaths.saheeh: And by the dawn when it breathes
night-oaths.khattab: and the day as it breaks
night-oaths.arberry: by the dawn sighing,
night-oaths.pickthall: And the breath of morning

night-as-sign.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ لِتَسۡكُنُواْ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوۡمࣲ يَسۡمَعُونَ
night-as-sign.saheeh: It is He who made for you the night to rest therein and the day, giving sight. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
night-as-sign.khattab: He is the One Who has made the night for you to rest in and the day bright. Surely in this are signs for people who listen
night-as-sign.arberry: It is He who made for you the night to repose in it, and the day, to see; surely in that are signs for a people who have ears.
night-as-sign.pickthall: He it is Who hath appointed for you the night that ye should rest therein and the day giving sight. Lo! herein verily are portents for a folk that heed.
